summary.text: Bloodwing Demon Sect is the organisation Fang Yuan founded in his previous life in the Middle Kingdom, with ranked posts that drew tens of thousands of people under him.

claims.text: In Fang Yuan’s previous life he founded the Bloodwing Demon Sect in the Middle Kingdom, where he taught up to tens of thousands of people. He erected the positions of demon soldiers, demon generals, demon sages, and others. Each position gave corresponding benefits, letting countless people flock over, letting Fang Yuan order them around.
He created the Bloodwing Demon Sect by relying on system and human emotions to make an enormous influence. Ten thousands would come forth with his one call, seizing resources and fighting enemies.

When he broke through to rank six in that previous life, he saw a new scene. Gu Masters up to rank five were mortals, rank six were immortals. An enormous influence was a powerful help and at the same time an enormous burden. What one could truly rely on was oneself.
He had created the Bloodwing Demon Sect and taught countless people, which is why account books look clear to him.

In that previous life he established the Bloodwing Devil Sect, and the symbol of the sect was the bladewing blood bat. Resources from the devil sect were more than enough to support close to ten thousand bladewing blood bat Gu, letting the sect establish a terrifying might and spread terror. He owed that success to bladewing blood bats.
After over four hundred years in that previous life, he obtained a Blood Sea Ancestor inheritance. With colonies of bladewing blood bats and rank five cultivation, he became an overlord of a region.

Fang Yuan had created the bloodwing demonic sect in his previous life, so if he wanted to establish an organisation in this life it would be easier because he had already done it. In that previous life he established it to gather resources. In this life, with knowledge of many inheritances and secrets, he judges he can devour those resources and rise to rank six much more quickly, without wasting time creating a force of his own.

In Fang Yuan’s previous life, he escaped southern border and arrived at central continent, becoming a Gu Immortal. After creating the bloodwing demonic sect, Feng Jin Huang was his mortal enemy. They had at least a few hundred battles, and eventually Fang Yuan allied with numerous demonic path Gu Immortals and attacked Hu Immortal blessed land together, paying a painful price to kill her.
